claude_proposed_widenings.name: convert_miss_to_hit
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Peerless Aim lets the bearer retroactively declare that a missed attack roll hits instead. No existing EffectAtom models post-roll outcome substitution — this is distinct from modify_roll_numeric (pre-roll delta), modify_roll_advantage (advantage/disadvantage), and modify_crit_range (crit threshold). It is a retroactive roll-outcome override, a new concept not present in v4.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: When you miss with an attack roll, you can hit instead.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: ReactionTrigger.caster_misses_attack_roll
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Peerless Aim fires when the bearer misses with their own attack roll. ReactionTrigger currently covers: hit_by_attack_roll (incoming), targeted_by_named_spell, creature_casts_spell, spell_save_outcome, any_of — none covers the bearer's own outgoing attack missing.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: When you miss with an attack roll, you can hit instead.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: modify_ability_score.ability: Ability | CastTimeChoice<Ability>
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The ASI on this feat says 'one ability score of your choice' — a build-time open selection over all six abilities. modify_ability_score.ability is typed as Ability (fixed). Needs widening to Ability | CastTimeChoice<Ability> to represent player-picks-any-ability grants.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 30.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: CompositeFeatMechanics
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The feat has both a passive grant (ASI) and an activated ability (Peerless Aim). FeatMechanics = PassiveMechanics | ActivatedAbilityMechanics — no composite form. CompositeClassFeatureMechanics exists for class features; the same pattern is needed for feats.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Ability Score Increase [...] Peerless Aim. When you miss with an attack roll, you can hit instead.
